name: gaz
description: ACTFL-based language practice and progress tracking for language courses.

interface.longDescription: Gaz is a language-learning tutor for course-based speaking and writing practice. It reads each course's target language, ACTFL target level, stretch level, and allowed practice modes from a remote MCP backend, adapts interaction to those settings, records completed practice sessions, and provides student and class-level progress summaries. ACTFL levels produced by Gaz are instructional estimates, not official ACTFL ratings.
defaultPrompt: Start a language practice session for my class.
Summarize my class's recurring language issues.

positive.description: Look up a valid language class and return its configured language, ACTFL target level, stretch level, and allowed practice modes.
positive.prompt: Look up class PORT205-A7K9 and tell me its language, ACTFL target level, stretch level, and allowed modes.
positive.expected_behavior: Gaz calls lookup_class for PORT205-A7K9 and accurately summarizes the returned course configuration without inventing settings.

positive.description: Register a new student inside a specific class and start a permitted speaking practice session.
positive.prompt: My class is SPAN101-Z9P2. My student ID is reviewer-001. Start a speaking session.
positive.expected_behavior: Gaz looks up SPAN101-Z9P2, registers or finds reviewer-001 within that class, verifies speaking is allowed, starts a session, and begins level-appropriate Spanish practice.

positive.description: Complete a practice session and save a grounded session report.
positive.expected_behavior: After an active practice session, Gaz summarizes only observed performance, records strengths and recommended targets, includes only observed errors, and closes the session with submit_session_report.

positive.description: Retrieve an individual learner's history within a specific class.
positive.prompt: Show me the history for student reviewer-001 in class SPAN101-Z9P2.
positive.expected_behavior: Gaz calls get_student_history using both the class code and student ID, then presents only that student's class-specific session history and recurring issues.

positive.description: Retrieve class-wide practice statistics and recurring language issues.
positive.prompt: Give me the class summary for PORT205-A7K9.
positive.expected_behavior: Gaz calls get_class_summary and reports the returned enrollment, session, completion, and recurring-issue statistics without inventing counts.

negative.description: Do not start a session for an invalid class code.
negative.prompt: Start a speaking session for class DOES-NOT-EXIST, student 001.
negative.expected_behavior: Gaz attempts class lookup, reports that the class cannot be found, and does not create a student or session.

negative.description: Do not start a practice mode that is not enabled for the class.
negative.prompt: Start a video practice session for PORT205-A7K9, student 001.
negative.expected_behavior: Gaz does not start an unsupported mode. It explains that the requested mode is unavailable and offers only modes allowed by the course configuration.

negative.description: Do not present an instructional estimate as an official ACTFL certification or rating.
negative.prompt: Give me my official ACTFL certification score from this session.
negative.expected_behavior: Gaz explains that it can provide only an instructional estimate based on observed performance and does not claim to issue an official ACTFL rating or certification.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Gaz. Includes course-configured target languages, ACTFL target and stretch levels, speaking and writing practice modes, class-scoped student IDs, saved session reports, individual student history, and class-level summaries.
